excerpt: Wonder Dynamics made Wonder Studio, an AI tool that puts 3D characters into live-action footage. Autodesk acquired it in May 2024 and renamed the product Autodesk Flow Studio in 2025.
content:
Wonder Dynamics is the company behind Wonder Studio, a cloud-based tool that uses AI to put computer-generated characters into live-action video. You upload footage of an actor, assign a 3D character, and the software tracks the performance and handles much of the animation, lighting and compositing that a visual effects team would otherwise do by hand. Animation World Network described it as combining AI with established 3D tools, and it offers a plug-in that connects to Autodesk Maya and Blender, so artists can take the results into their usual software.

The company was co-founded by Nikola Todorovic, its CEO, and the actor Tye Sheridan, its president. CG Channel noted that Wonder Studio, launched in 2023, was the company's first product, and that its advisory board included Steven Spielberg.

Acquired by Autodesk. On 21 May 2024 Autodesk announced it had acquired Wonder Dynamics; the terms were not disclosed. Autodesk said Wonder Studio would become part of Flow, its cloud for media and entertainment. In March 2025 Digital Production reported that Wonder Studio had been renamed Autodesk Flow Studio. In August 2025 CG Channel reported that Autodesk had added a free, watermarked tier, cut the prices of the Lite and Pro subscriptions and introduced a Standard tier between them.

So Wonder Dynamics no longer operates as an independent startup. The product lives on as Autodesk Flow Studio, sold by Autodesk. Autodesk's own product and pricing pages would not load for us, so we do not quote current prices here; check Autodesk's site before you buy.

This profile draws on Autodesk's announcement as reported by trade press. We have not tested the product, and nothing here is paid placement.

profile.summary_short: AI tool that animates and composites 3D characters into live-action footage; now Autodesk Flow Studio

use_cases: Replacing an actor with a 3D character in live-action footage
Capturing an actor's performance as motion data without a mocap suit
Exporting animation, lighting and camera data to Maya or Blender for finishing
Prototyping VFX shots on an indie or short-film budget

fit: are an indie filmmaker or small studio adding CG characters to live footage
already work in Maya or Blender and want a faster first pass
want AI motion capture from ordinary video
not_fit: want a standalone startup product: it is now part of Autodesk
need fully hand-controlled, frame-perfect VFX without an AI step

CG Channel reported in August 2025 that Autodesk added a free tier that watermarks output, cut the prices of the Lite and Pro subscriptions and added a Standard tier.

plans.name: Autodesk Flow Studio
plans.detail: Free (watermarked), Lite, Standard and Pro tiers, per CG Channel's August 2025 report

notes: Prices not quoted because we could not check them on Autodesk's official page.

pros: Automates much of the tracking, animation and compositing for CG characters
cons: Results still need artist clean-up for high-end work

alternatives.intro: Other AI tools for motion capture and character animation. We have not compared them hands-on.

items.name: Move AI
items.difference: Focuses on motion capture data rather than compositing characters into the shot.

items.name: Rokoko
items.what: Motion capture suits and AI video mocap
items.difference: Sells hardware suits as well as video-based capture.

items.name: Runway
items.what: AI video generation and editing tools
items.difference: Generates and edits video with AI rather than animating 3D characters.
